why: D-20260916-10 (owner, 2026-09-16): the Ayurveda training hub is /ayurveda-training-programme/ - the URL Google already rates (70,193 impressions, position 7.5) - carrying the hub layout that /ayurveda-training-programs/ had; /ayurveda-training-programs/ keeps serving the same page and canonicalises to the hub. Its legacy title ('Kairali Memberships | Affiliations | Accreditations') was wrong for the page and is replaced by the hub's approved title. Applied by tools/repair-route-manifest.mjs after every import. 2026-09-17: the five training course routes mount their generated course views (tools/build-course-views.mjs) instead of the generic article reader; their approved head metadata is unchanged. 2026-09-19: ten orphaned routes with no inbound links and no search traffic - three shop leftovers on a site with no shop, four '-old' duplicates of pages that now exist properly, two test pages and a stray French apply-now - are excluded from the sitemap. They still serve; nothing is unpublished. 2026-09-19 (owner, page-by-page): four thin legacy pages canonicalise to the fuller page on the same subject and leave the sitemap - /our-story/ (96% identical to /about-us/), /offers/new/ (93% identical to the senior-citizen offer), the cancer supportive-care legacy page and /panchakarma/. /learn-about-ayurveda/ is explicitly kept IN the sitemap. The /sitemap/ page carried an offers-page title and now carries its own.
